source.prompt: Seamless tileable texture, square, 2048x2048. Orthographic top-down view, a flat, front-on decorative panel filling the whole frame edge to edge. Flat, even, shadowless lighting, as if scanned: no highlights, no vignette, no shading gradient across the image. No perspective, no objects, no text, no border, no watermark. The left edge must continue into the right edge and the top into the bottom. Material: Flat, front-on decorative panel of twined Chilkat and Ravenstail ceremonial blanket textile woven from mountain-goat wool and shredded yellow-cedar bark yarn: tactile raised twined cords forming two columns of stylized zoomorphic Raven and Orca ovoids and split-U wing-boxes (strictly zero human faces) interlocked with horizontal borders of Pictish La Tene double-spirals, dyed in lignite-black (#141619), celadonite-teal (#2e9488), rabbitbrush weld-gold (#d19a3a), falu-red (#b63124), slickrock-orchil purple (#5e2750), and cream wool (#efe7d6), whole crests inside seams. Full colour.
